description: The question card: a hooks module, on by default. After a turn it may ask the user one question, above the prompt, about something they may have skipped or misunderstood in Claude's answer (one Sonnet call on turns it judges), writes each finished question to ~/.hus-criteria-gap/log/, and adds /criteria-check. Off where .hus-criteria-gap/config.json (project, else global) says "card": false.
